title: Prepare a governed runtime remediation batch for schema, write authority, and queue readiness

phases.objective: Prepare a no-secret, prepared-only remediation plan and contract guard for runtime schema, write-authority, and queue readiness without applying migrations, grants, or production activation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The remediation batch contract test runs on the exact PR candidate.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The plan validates exact migration checksums, direct-table authority profiles, queue decision paths, and all prepared-only boundaries without connecting to runtime or executing SQL.
steps: Read the runtime database readiness and write-authority contracts.
Validate the mcp catalog migration and capability envelope ledger migration checksums.
Validate runtime inventory writer table bindings and allowed operations.
Validate Redis and SQL fallback decision requirements.
Run the contract test and include it in the canonical test manifest.
Keep migration, grant, database, provider, production activation, and GitHub policy effects disabled.
assertions: The remediation plan remains status prepared-only and authority shadow-library-only.
runtime_mutation_allowed, grant_mutation_allowed, migration_apply_allowed, and production_activation_allowed remain false.
The mcp catalog and envelope ledger checksums match the repository files.
The runtime inventory writer uses direct-table bindings with SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE only and no grant option.
Redis is a decision path and SQL fallback is explicitly safe-degradation only.
No migration, grant, SQL/DB mutation, provider mutation, credential read, force-push, Branch Protection/Rulesets Apply, or Production activation occurs.
